item.title: How BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA Uses Anime and Manga Culture To Shape Its Identity
item.content:encoded: The musical adventures of the girls bands in BanG Dream! have always been integrated with anime. But as a new entry BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA is even more marinated in said culture. The characters of YUME∞MITA live adjacent to Akihabara, long seen as a mecca of otaku culture in Japan. So, of course these girls are going to be steeped in anime and manga material, and it shapes both their identities and the vibe of YUME∞MITA.

item.title: BanG Dream! Now Has a Real Villain in Viola
item.content:encoded: All stories are fundamentally based on conflict. However cute girls band stories of BanG Dream! don't generally feature outright antagonists. Until YUME∞MITA gave us Viola.

item.title: Mobile Suit Gundam Hathaway: The Sorcery of Nymph Circe Anime Film Review
item.content:encoded: If deep character explorations and interpersonal drama are your cup of tea, you'll get your fill. If you're just in it for giant robots fighting each other, you'll get that too.
